about: Key-check test fixture: Elden Ring slot_data from seeds generated locally with Archipelago 0.6.8 and the Elden Ring apworld 0.1.4 (location names Copyright (c) 2026 Bedrock, Modified MIT, see src/data/apworld-licence.txt), trimmed to what the rebuild reads. Names are stored once in `names`; everything else refers to them by index. `notChecks` counts the priority names the generator printed that are not checks in the room (the paid tie-in DLC and omitted shop rows); `trimmed` counts the spots a multiworld trimmed at random. `important` lists the spots a multiworld seed put another slot's progression on, read from the seed for testing only. The All Bosses seed's options are the preset's, in src/data/presets/all-bosses.ts.
